# Astronomy Engine (vendored)

`astronomy.browser.min.js` is version 2.1.19 of [Astronomy Engine](https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy)
by Don Cross, copied unmodified from the `astronomy-engine` npm package. It defines the global
`Astronomy`. MIT license; see `LICENSE`.

To upgrade, replace the file with the new release's `astronomy.browser.min.js`, update the version
here and in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, and re-check the night model against reference data.
